E4Plus1.uk.description: Bart's Birthday: Bart has to organise his own birthday party when Homer forgets to post the invitations. Mr Burns fakes his own death. (S36 Ep1/18)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Yellow Lotus: The Simpsons stumble across a mystery and an old enemy while they're on holiday at a peculiar island resort. Dr Hibbert drugs an otter. (S36 Ep2/18)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Goldbergs
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Kara-te Kid: Inspired by the Karate Kid films, Adam and the other Adam Goldberg face off in a karate match to settle their long-running feud for good. (S4 Ep16)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Goldbergs
E4Plus1.uk.description: Baré: When Lainey wins a scholarship to a top art college, Barry considers modifying his dream of becoming a doctor to go with her. (S4 Ep18)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: A Fair to Remember: The family go to the annual school fair, and Phil plans a big 20th wedding anniversary surprise for Claire at the fairgrounds. (S5 Ep7)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: ClosetCon '13: Jay begrudgingly returns to ClosetCon, and things get interesting when he's reunited with some old colleagues. Cam takes Mitch and Lily to the Tucker family farm. (S5 Ep8)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Big Game: With a big football game coming up and a record to break, Coach Cam is intensely focused and showing no mercy, even when the opposition are at a disadvantage. (S5 Ep9)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Old Man & the Tree: Jay takes Manny out to cut down a Christmas tree. Gloria is on edge with Mum in town, but changes her tune when she sees her bonding with Claire. (S5 Ep10)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Little Orphan Millie: When Milhouse's parents remarry and go on a honeymoon cruise, their boat capsizes and they're presumed dead, so Milhouse acquires a new macho attitude. (S19 Ep6/20)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Husbands and Knives: Comic Book Guy sells The Android's Dungeon to Marge, who turns it into a women-only gym. (S19 Ep7/20)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Funeral for a Fiend: Sideshow Bob is put on trial for trying to murder the Simpsons. At the trial, Bart inadvertently kills him - but is he really dead? (S19 Ep8/20)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Treehouse of Horror XVIII: Bart helps Kodos to contact his home planet, Homer lives a double life as a government assassin, and Ned Flanders turns the church into a hell house. (S19 Ep5/20)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Itchy & Scratchy & Poochie Show: Homer gets a job on The Itchy & Scratchy Show as the voice of hip-hop surfer dog Poochie, a character brought in to boost viewing figures. (S8 Ep14/25)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Chopper: When Chief Madeline Wuntch allows Peralta to work on his dream case, Captain Holt worries that she's setting the precinct up to fail. (S2 Ep22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: First Dates
E4Plus1.uk.description: 'Alpha male' Josh is looking for his very own Kardashian. Is glam 25-year-old Yasmin his match? And will waxing entrepreneur Sherie's Marilyn Monroe dress be a hit with Richard? (S14 Ep4)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Gogglebox
E4Plus1.uk.description: Great Expectations and Rise and Fall are on the box this time. And Wild Isles, Tempting Fortune, Married at First Sight Australia and Dance 100. (S21 Ep6)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Gogglebox
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Goggleboxers watch The Great Celebrity Bake Off for SU2C, Race Across the World, Love Is Blind, The Dog Academy, Beef, Outlast and ITV News on criminal charges against Trump. (S21 Ep7)
